choice_rationale: The benchmark is already frozen. Altering the held-out structural split to add HARD/TIE tasks would be a post-hoc modification of the test set immediately before the model experiment. HARD/TIE structural generalization is deferred to a future benchmark identity rather than injected into I3.3.2 in place.

structural_held_out_limitation.establishes: Topology generalization at easy-to-moderate oracle decision margins on structurally novel topologies (zero exact-structure overlap with development/validation).
does_not_establish: Topology generalization on near-threshold HARD decisions (q-margin band HARD absent from this split).
Topology generalization on exact ties (q-margin band TIE absent from this split).
Any claim about structural-OOD performance on HARD or TIE decisions.
structural_held_out_limitation.deferred_to_future_benchmark: HARD/TIE structural generalization, to be addressed by a new corpus and new benchmark identity (not by modifying I3.3.2).

preregistered_depth_stratified_analyses.measures: Novel topology generalization WITHOUT simultaneously extrapolating control horizon. Depth-1 tasks isolate the topology-novelty component because the planning horizon is minimal.
preregistered_depth_stratified_analyses.interpretation_rule: A aware-vs-blind gap here attributes to exploiting novel topology, not to longer-horizon planning.

preregistered_depth_stratified_analyses.measures: Novel topology generalization AND longer planning horizon extrapolation jointly. This conflates two extrapolation axes by design.
preregistered_depth_stratified_analyses.interpretation_rule: Do not collapse this into a pure topology-generalization claim. A gap here may arise from either novel topology, longer horizon, or both.

interpretation_separation_rule: STRUCTURE_SHALLOW_TOPOLOGY and STRUCTURE_TOPOLOGY_PLUS_HORIZON must be reported as two distinct analyses. They must not be collapsed into a single 'structural held-out' interpretation.

topology_x_depth_x_difficulty_reporting.rule: For the I3.4 scientific report, construct cells by topology-novelty x depth x difficulty. Report which cells exist and their n; statistical power is not required in every cell.
topology_x_depth_x_difficulty_reporting.structural_hard_claim_prohibition: No HARD or TIE structural-OOD cell exists; no HARD/TIE structural-generalization claim may be made from this benchmark.

primary_scientific_question: DG_aware < DG_blind, where DG = V_O* - V^pi (decision gap: the value the controller forfeits versus the observable oracle).
efficiency_question: C_aware <= C_blind, or at minimum no disproportionate cost increase.
